verdict.rationale: USPTO runs real API surfaces: api.uspto.gov answers with an auth challenge, and Patent Center mentions direct API calls. A downloadable spec is therefore a fair question, but no evidence shows one exists. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the developer portal serves only a JavaScript app shell to a plain fetch, so no machine-readable spec was retrievable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
